reviews.text: I took my dog here for grooming and was disappointed with the results. His haircut was uneven, with some areas left much longer than others, and it was not because of matting. I included a photo of his paw showing long pieces of hair sticking out that were missed. His nails were also trimmed inconsistently—some were cut, while others on the same paws looked like they hadn’t been touched at all. I expected much better attention to detail.

For over 6 years, I have been taking my Cocker Spaniel to Furry Tails Dog Grooming, and I have always been very satisfied with their service. They are very friendly, professional, and do an excellent job. I have also used their boarding service and had a great experience. I will definitely continue trusting them with the care of my dog. Highly recommended!

I’ve been bringing my two pups, Chuck and Lucky, here since the very beginning of their grooming days, and I couldn’t be happier. Every single time, they come home looking so fresh, clean, and pristine. I drive an extra 20 minutes just to see this team because I trust them completely with my dogs.

Now that my pups are older and need a little more attention, the groomers go above and beyond to make sure they’re comfortable and cared for. Once, Chuck had a small accident, and without hesitation, they rewashed and dried him so he’d go home fresh. That level of kindness and patience really shows how much they care.

It’s rare to find consistent, high-quality service paired with such genuine love for the dogs they groom. I’m always impressed and so thankful to have found them. Highly recommend to any pet parent looking for top-notch care!

Today was my baby´s first time at the groomers and believe me when I say I was SO NERVOUS. My puppy is my everything, I do not trust easily when it comes to her. From the moment I walked in, I was so welcomed. My baby was so nervous and shaking, it made it even more nerve wrecking for me. I dropped off at 7:30 and by 10:00 I received a call she was ready for pick up. I paid $55. Every penny was worth it. Seeing my baby come out with her little bows was everything to me. She wasn’t shaking, she wasn’t barking or crying. She was relaxed and happy. I almost feel like she wasn’t ready to be picked up! I will most definitely be back!

I’ve been going to Furry Tales Dog Grooming for a while, but my recent experience was so disappointing that I doubt I’ll be back. I was running just a few minutes late due to traffic, so I called ahead to let them know. When I arrived four minutes past my scheduled time, I was surprised to be told they wouldn’t take my dog. It felt like they had zero understanding or flexibility.

On top of that, the reception area wasn’t clean. There was pee on the floor, and when I politely pointed it out to the two ladies at the front, they barely reacted. They didn’t even get up to take care of it, which felt unprofessional and honestly a little gross.

It’s sad to see how things have changed with the new management. The place used to feel welcoming, but now it seems like they don’t care much about customer service. If you’re looking for a groomer who’s reliable and respectful, I’d suggest looking somewhere else.

I always bring my Yorkie in for grooming as needed. This time, I opted for a summer short cut, and I loved it - she looks a bit funny, but still adorable. However, I'm confused about their appointment policy. They claim it's appointment-only, yet my mom brought her three dogs in without an appointment on separate days. When I asked her how she managed to get them in, she said she simply dropped them off before 11 a.m. I used to be able to do that, but now I have to wait two weeks to a month for an appointment, which is inconvenient due to my work schedule. Despite this inconsistency, I've been a happy customer every time.
